packageRules.description: Indirect Go dependencies stay at what the direct ones require. Bumping oapi-codegen's indirect dependencies on their own once broke code generation (mixed yaml v3/v4); CI's 'generated code up to date' job catches that.
oapi-codegen is a tool dependency (listed as indirect); update it explicitly so generated code is refreshed with it.
Keep the Go toolchain in go.mod and the build image in step.
